package.description: A notch for Windows 11 showing how much of your Claude, ChatGPT and Gemini usage is left.

en-US.description: A notch for Windows 11 showing how much of your Claude, ChatGPT and Gemini usage is left.
en-US.longDescription:
Notchpoint hangs a small pill from the top edge of the primary display showing one
ring per AI provider, so you can see how much of your allowance is left at a glance.
Hovering reveals it and clicking expands a card with a bar and a reset time for each
rate-limit window.

It reads Claude usage from Claude Code's own credentials, ChatGPT usage from the Codex
CLI's, and Gemini usage from Antigravity over loopback. Credentials are read only,
never written and never refreshed. There is no telemetry and no update check.

It also shows whether a Claude Code session is working or waiting on you, and stays
out of the way, hiding entirely while a fullscreen app owns the screen.
en-US.name: Notchpoint
